availability_notions.globally_published: Space-Track CREATION_DATE has passed. A fact about the catalogue, NOT about the endpoint.
availability_notions.available_to_endpoint: The element has been provisioned to the device at a refresh event. Only elements with CREATION_DATE <= t_refresh are eligible.
availability_notions.currently_held: The single frozen element/model/scaler/gate state used for every transmission until the next refresh.

system_assumption: The endpoint does NOT poll Space-Track. It receives a provisioning payload on a fixed schedule and operates open-loop between refreshes: no satellite downlink beacon, no newly published element, no label feedback.
retracted_statement: 'a fresher element was already published, therefore the stale element could not be used' -- valid only under continuous/immediate provisioning, which is NOT the primary model here.

primary_policy.offset_rationale: 1 h spacing is incommensurate with the 1.583 h sampling period, so orbital phase decorrelates from TLE age across offsets without any random jitter.

sensitivity_variants_dataset_counts_only.rule: t_refresh at every element availability time

availability_clock.justification: E0 year-stratified audit: 1998-2003 is archive backfill (lag up to 50337 h); 2004-2013 has 52-94 percent negative lag; 2014-2026 has 0 percent negative lag with p50 0.96-5.76 h.

reference_quality_rules_preregistered.epoch_offset_note: EPOCH(reference) may be before or after t_tx; only |EPOCH(ref) - t_tx| <= 48 h is required, to exclude backfilled or stale-solution rows.

label_semantics.name: later-solution, model-derived reference
label_semantics.training_rule: usable at refresh t_refresh only if t_close <= t_refresh
label_semantics.deployment_rule: t_close > t_tx by construction; the residual cannot inform any decision before the next refresh after closure

band_note: Bands are assigned from ACTUAL age_tx = t_tx - EPOCH(stale). Refresh interval and TLE age are NOT interchangeable.

fixed_config.screen_note: Applied per transmission as a physical-plausibility filter. Raw residual is persisted unscreened so S2 criterion 6 can vary the threshold without refitting.
